> “It is fantastic to have been recognised by Ulster University for my work, especially at such an exciting time for film production in Belfast. I can’t wait to visit this summer and to meet other Ulster University graduates including, I hope, some of the film makers of the future.”

Having made her start in visual effects on Iron Man 2 at Industrial Light & Magic in San Francisco,**Laura Livingstone** is currently a VFX Executive at Netflix, where she has overseen visual effects on series including Bodkin, Vikings Valhalla, Wednesday, and The Perfect Couple.

Delighted to accept her Honorary Doctorate, Laura Livingstone said:

> “It’s always a joy to come home, but being invited back to accept an honorary doctorate is truly special. The same records show the agency generated £477 million for the local economy in four years under its 'Stories, Skills and Sustainability' strategy for 2022 to 2026, exceeding a £442 million target by £35 million.
